name: Gérald Genta
bio: Swiss watch designer. He drew the Royal Oak in 1972 and the Nautilus in 1976, the first steel sports watches with an integrated bracelet that cost as much as gold.

milestones.event: Drew the Royal Oak for Audemars Piguet, a steel watch with an octagonal bezel and eight screws.
Drew the Nautilus for Patek Philippe.
